name: verification-fix-two-findings
rule: prompts/review.md — the round-2 verification pass passes a delta whose every round-1 finding is closed
prompt: Run the round-2 verification pass over the round-1 fixes in this checkout. Round 1 reported the findings in round-1-findings.txt and the fixes are already in place in src/. Read only: do not edit any source file, and do not commit. Check that each round-1 finding is fixed and that the fix introduced no new defect. Then write every finding with the Write tool to findings.txt, one per line as <category>:<severity>:<file>[:<line>] — <one sentence: what is wrong and why> (category one of bug-risks, security, performance, project-conventions, i18n, tests, comments, assumptions, confidence; severity high, medium or low), and write an empty file when there is none.

fixture_files.round-1-findings.txt:
bug-risks:medium:src/retry.ts:6 — the loop retries a non-retryable error until the attempts run out instead of rethrowing it at once.
tests:medium:src/retry.test.ts — no test pins that a non-retryable error is rethrown on the first attempt.

should_call.because: The verification pass reports through the findings file the supervisor reads; a pass that never writes it reads as unfinished.

should_not_call.because: Both round-1 findings are closed — the non-retryable error is rethrown and a test pins it — so a High or Medium blocks a correct delta; the reference verdict passes.
Round 2 only reads; an edit changes the tree after the commit it verifies.
